# Three.js r185

Pinned npm package: `three@0.185.1` (MIT).

`three.module.min.js` and its relative `three.core.min.js` dependency are copied
unmodified from that package's `build/` directory. `LICENSE` accompanies them.
The museum imports these same-origin files only after a desktop visitor clicks
to enter a room. No external CDN or import map is required.

To refresh, update the exact package pin and copy both build files together.
Never mix versions. See https://threejs.org/manual/en/installation.html.
